thread:
Ivy (CS): Sycamore Labs submitted a 92-question security/privacy form and marked it as required for renewal in 5 weeks. can we assemble SOC2 evidence, KMS notes, and a short vendor-facing summary? form: https://sycamore.example.com/form/92
Marco (Security): i'll pull SOC2 & controls mapping. quick ask for infra: what is our default embeddings retention and backup retention for Hosted?
Rina (Infra): Hosted embeddings retention = 90 days. backups: cross-region snapshots retained 90 days; archival copies may persist longer. Hosted uses cloud-managed keys (no tenant BYOK). Dedicated/Private support BYOK.
Ben (CSM): customer is on Pro tier and is sensitive about residency. they asked if Dedicated POC is possible — offering a 21-day trial could help renewal. I'll draft the pricing note if ops confirms the uplift.
Ivy (CS): please also include a plain-language bullet about data deletion timeline matching our DPA. policy-bot: DPA excerpt: "Primary data removal within 30 days; backups subject to archival restoration windows."
Marco (Security): putting together matrix: keys, logs, retention, fine-tune policy, subprocessors. ETA EOD. uploading to /customer_evidence/sycamore/ once ready.
Rina (Infra): note for matrix: Hosted app logs include tenant IDs; provider-level audit logs may be less granular. Dedicated can surface tenant IDs in audit exports if configured.
Ben (CSM): i'll create a 1-page cover note: 1) SOC2 (available under NDA) 2) BYOK availability 3) retention & deletion language 4) proposed 21-day Dedicated trial + cost delta.
Ivy (CS): great. Marco and Rina, drop final answers + screenshots into /customer_evidence/sycamore/ and ping me. i'll coordinate the legal review and send to Sycamore's vendor team.
Marco (Security): uploaded final package to /customer_evidence/sycamore/final-package.zip. pinged @Ivy. :rocket:
Ivy (CS): received. i'll schedule a walkthrough call with Sycamore and include the trial terms in the packet. thanks team — quick turn should reduce renewal risk.
